=== JSON Schema ===
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "filing_manager_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Cover-page filing-manager name (e.g., 'VANGUARD GROUP INC'). Note: the filer-agent CIK in the EDGAR submission is often the filing agent, not the manager itself."
    },
    "report_calendar_quarter_end": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Period of report. Filed in MM-DD-YYYY format on the cover page; normalize to ISO YYYY-MM-DD before comparison."
    },
    "is_amendment": {
      "type": [
        "boolean",
        "null"
      ],
      "description": "True for 13F-HR/A. When true, supersedes the original for the same (manager, period). Output null when the cover page does not state amendment status."
    },
    "amendment_type": {
      "type": [
        "string",
        "null"
      ],
      "description": "When is_amendment=true, one of 'RESTATEMENT' or 'NEW HOLDINGS'."
    },
    "report_type": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "13F HOLDINGS REPORT",
        "13F NOTICE",
        "13F COMBINATION REPORT"
      ],
      "description": "Filing role. Combination reports include positions held on behalf of other managers; Notice means the manager is filing nothing this quarter (covered elsewhere)."
    },
    "is_confidential_omitted": {
      "type": [
        "boolean",
        "null"
      ],
      "description": "True when the manager has filed a 13F-CTR for confidential treatment of specific positions; the InfoTable then omits those rows. Output null when the cover page does not state this. Do NOT default to false."
    },
    "table_entry_total": {
      "type": "integer",
      "description": "Cover-page count of holdings rows. Should equal len(holdings) — useful as a self-consistency check."
    },
    "table_value_total_usd": {
      "type": "integer",
      "description": "Cover-page total market value across all positions. Since 2023-Q1 reported in whole dollars (was thousands earlier). Should equal sum(holdings[].value_usd)."
    },
    "holdings": {
      "type": "array",
      "description": "InfoTable: one row per Section 13(f) reportable security. Each <infoTable> in the InfoTable XML maps to one record here.",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "issuer_name": {
            "type": "string",
            "description": "nameOfIssuer, verbatim from filing (e.g. 'BROOKFIELD CORP', 'ACCENTURE PLC IRELAND'). Often uppercase."
          },
          "title_of_class": {
            "type": "string",
            "description": "Security class title (e.g. 'COM' for common stock, 'CL A LTD VT SH', 'SHS CLASS A', 'CALL', 'PUT', 'WTS'). Usually uppercase abbreviations, ≤150 chars."
          },
          "cusip": {
            "type": "string",
            "description": "9-character CUSIP. XSD allows mixed case but most filings use uppercase. Normalize to uppercase for matching."
          },
          "figi": {
            "type": [
              "string",
              "null"
            ],
            "description": "Optional 12-character FIGI (Bloomberg). Reportable since 2023-Q1 amendments; most filers do not include it."
          },
          "value_usd": {
            "type": "integer",
            "description": "Market value in whole dollars (integer). Pre-2023 filings used thousands; post-2023 always whole dollars."
          },
          "shares_or_principal_amount": {
            "type": "integer",
            "description": "sshPrnamt: count of shares (when type=SH) or principal amount (when type=PRN)."
          },
          "shares_or_principal_type": {
            "type": "string",
            "enum": [
              "SH",
              "PRN"
            ],
            "description": "SH=shares, PRN=principal-amount. Common stock is always SH; convertible bonds use PRN."
          },
          "put_call": {
            "type": [
              "string",
              "null"
            ],
            "enum": [
              "Put",
              "Call",
              null
            ],
            "description": "Set when the position is an option. Same CUSIP can appear three times in one filing: common stock + Call + Put."
          },
          "investment_discretion": {
            "type": "string",
            "enum": [
              "SOLE",
              "DFND",
              "OTR"
            ],
            "description": "Manager's discretion: SOLE=sole, DFND=defined (with sub-advisors), OTR=other. Same security can appear under different discretions in the same filing."
          },
          "other_manager": {
            "type": [
              "string",
              "null"
            ],
            "description": "Optional reference to other_manager block when investment_discretion=DFND or =OTR. Free-form."
          },
          "voting_authority_sole": {
            "type": "integer",
            "description": "Shares for which manager has sole voting authority."
          },
          "voting_authority_shared": {
            "type": "integer",
            "description": "Shares with shared voting authority."
          },
          "voting_authority_none": {
            "type": "integer",
            "description": "Shares with no voting authority."
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "issuer_name",
          "title_of_class",
          "cusip",
          "value_usd",
          "shares_or_principal_amount",
          "shares_or_principal_type",
          "investment_discretion",
          "voting_authority_sole",
          "voting_authority_shared",
          "voting_authority_none"
        ]
      }
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "filing_manager_name",
    "report_calendar_quarter_end",
    "report_type",
    "table_entry_total",
    "table_value_total_usd",
    "holdings"
  ]
}

json_schema: {"type": "object", "properties": {"filing_manager_name": {"type": "string", "description": "Cover-page filing-manager name (e.g., 'VANGUARD GROUP INC'). Note: the filer-agent CIK in the EDGAR submission is often the filing agent, not the manager itself."}, "report_calendar_quarter_end": {"type": "string", "description": "Period of report. Filed in MM-DD-YYYY format on the cover page; normalize to ISO YYYY-MM-DD before comparison."}, "is_amendment": {"type": ["boolean", "null"], "description": "True for 13F-HR/A. When true, supersedes the original for the same (manager, period). Output null when the cover page does not state amendment status."}, "amendment_type": {"type": ["string", "null"], "description": "When is_amendment=true, one of 'RESTATEMENT' or 'NEW HOLDINGS'."}, "report_type": {"type": "string", "enum": ["13F HOLDINGS REPORT", "13F NOTICE", "13F COMBINATION REPORT"], "description": "Filing role. Combination reports include positions held on behalf of other managers; Notice means the manager is filing nothing this quarter (covered elsewhere)."}, "is_confidential_omitted": {"type": ["boolean", "null"], "description": "True when the manager has filed a 13F-CTR for confidential treatment of specific positions; the InfoTable then omits those rows. Output null when the cover page does not state this. Do NOT default to false."}, "table_entry_total": {"type": "integer", "description": "Cover-page count of holdings rows. Should equal len(holdings) — useful as a self-consistency check."}, "table_value_total_usd": {"type": "integer", "description": "Cover-page total market value across all positions. Since 2023-Q1 reported in whole dollars (was thousands earlier). Should equal sum(holdings[].value_usd)."}, "holdings": {"type": "array", "description": "InfoTable: one row per Section 13(f) reportable security. Each <infoTable> in the InfoTable XML maps to one record here.", "items": {"type": "object", "properties": {"issuer_name": {"type": "string", "description": "nameOfIssuer, verbatim from filing (e.g. 'BROOKFIELD CORP', 'ACCENTURE PLC IRELAND'). Often uppercase."}, "title_of_class": {"type": "string", "description": "Security class title (e.g. 'COM' for common stock, 'CL A LTD VT SH', 'SHS CLASS A', 'CALL', 'PUT', 'WTS'). Usually uppercase abbreviations, ≤150 chars."}, "cusip": {"type": "string", "description": "9-character CUSIP. XSD allows mixed case but most filings use uppercase. Normalize to uppercase for matching."}, "figi": {"type": ["string", "null"], "description": "Optional 12-character FIGI (Bloomberg). Reportable since 2023-Q1 amendments; most filers do not include it."}, "value_usd": {"type": "integer", "description": "Market value in whole dollars (integer). Pre-2023 filings used thousands; post-2023 always whole dollars."}, "shares_or_principal_amount": {"type": "integer", "description": "sshPrnamt: count of shares (when type=SH) or principal amount (when type=PRN)."}, "shares_or_principal_type": {"type": "string", "enum": ["SH", "PRN"], "description": "SH=shares, PRN=principal-amount. Common stock is always SH; convertible bonds use PRN."}, "put_call": {"type": ["string", "null"], "enum": ["Put", "Call", null], "description": "Set when the position is an option. Same CUSIP can appear three times in one filing: common stock + Call + Put."}, "investment_discretion": {"type": "string", "enum": ["SOLE", "DFND", "OTR"], "description": "Manager's discretion: SOLE=sole, DFND=defined (with sub-advisors), OTR=other. Same security can appear under different discretions in the same filing."}, "other_manager": {"type": ["string", "null"], "description": "Optional reference to other_manager block when investment_discretion=DFND or =OTR. Free-form."}, "voting_authority_sole": {"type": "integer", "description": "Shares for which manager has sole voting authority."}, "voting_authority_shared": {"type": "integer", "description": "Shares with shared voting authority."}, "voting_authority_none": {"type": "integer", "description": "Shares with no voting authority."}}, "required": ["issuer_name", "title_of_class", "cusip", "value_usd", "shares_or_principal_amount", "shares_or_principal_type", "investment_discretion", "voting_authority_sole", "voting_authority_shared", "voting_authority_none"]}}}, "required": ["filing_manager_name", "report_calendar_quarter_end", "report_type", "table_entry_total", "table_value_total_usd", "holdings"]}

{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "filing_manager_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Cover-page filing-manager name (e.g., 'VANGUARD GROUP INC'). Note: the filer-agent CIK in the EDGAR submission is often the filing agent, not the manager itself."
    },
    "report_calendar_quarter_end": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Period of report. Filed in MM-DD-YYYY format on the cover page; normalize to ISO YYYY-MM-DD before comparison."
    },
    "is_amendment": {
      "type": [
        "boolean",
        "null"
      ],
      "description": "True for 13F-HR/A. When true, supersedes the original for the same (manager, period). Output null when the cover page does not state amendment status."
    },
    "amendment_type": {
      "type": [
        "string",
        "null"
      ],
      "description": "When is_amendment=true, one of 'RESTATEMENT' or 'NEW HOLDINGS'."
    },
    "report_type": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "13F HOLDINGS REPORT",
        "13F NOTICE",
        "13F COMBINATION REPORT"
      ],
      "description": "Filing role. Combination reports include positions held on behalf of other managers; Notice means the manager is filing nothing this quarter (covered elsewhere)."
    },
    "is_confidential_omitted": {
      "type": [
        "boolean",
        "null"
      ],
      "description": "True when the manager has filed a 13F-CTR for confidential treatment of specific positions; the InfoTable then omits those rows. Output null when the cover page does not state this. Do NOT default to false."
    },
    "table_entry_total": {
      "type": "integer",
      "description": "Cover-page count of holdings rows. Should equal len(holdings) — useful as a self-consistency check."
    },
    "table_value_total_usd": {
      "type": "integer",
      "description": "Cover-page total market value across all positions. Since 2023-Q1 reported in whole dollars (was thousands earlier). Should equal sum(holdings[].value_usd)."
    },

      "type": "array",

            "type": "string",

            "type": "string",

            "type": "string",

              "string",

            "type": "integer",

            "type": "integer",
            "description": "sshPrnamt: count of shares (when type=SH) or principal amount (when type=PRN)."

            "type": "string",
            "enum": [
              "SH",
              "PRN"

            "description": "SH=shares, PRN=principal-amount. Common stock is always SH; convertible bonds use PRN."

              "string",
              "null"

            "enum": [

            "type": "string",
            "enum": [
              "SOLE",
              "DFND",
              "OTR"

            "description": "Manager's discretion: SOLE=sole, DFND=defined (with sub-advisors), OTR=other. Same security can appear under different discretions in the same filing."

          "other_manager": {
            "type": [
              "string",
              "null"
            ],
            "description": "Optional reference to other_manager block when investment_discretion=DFND or =OTR. Free-form."

          "voting_authority_sole": {
            "type": "integer",
            "description": "Shares for which manager has sole voting authority."

          "voting_authority_shared": {
            "type": "integer",
            "description": "Shares with shared voting authority."
          },
          "voting_authority_none": {
            "type": "integer",

        "required": [

  "type": "object",
  "title": "Synthetic election statement-of-votes pivot schema",
  "description": "Extract the county header, the per-contest column definitions, and every precinct row from a precinct-by-precinct Statement of Votes Cast.   "required": [
    "jurisdiction",
    "election_title",
    "election_date",
    "contests",
    "precinct_results"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "jurisdiction": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "County named in the page header, e.g. 'Goshen County'."
    },
    "election_title": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Report title from the header, e.g. 'Official Precinct-by-Precinct Summary'."
    },
    "election_date": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Election date printed in the header, e.g. 'November 5, 2024'."
    },
    "contests": {
      "type": "array",
      "description": "One entry per contest (one per page), defining its columns in order.",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "required": [
          "office",
          "columns"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "office": {
            "type": "string",
            "description": "Contest title printed above the grid, e.g. 'United States Senator'."
          },
          "columns": {
            "type": "array",
            "description": "Data column headers left-to-right (candidates then Write-In, Over Votes, Under Votes); aligns positionally with each row's votes.",
            "items": {
              "type": "string"
            }
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "precinct_results": {
      "type": "array",
      "description": "Every precinct row of every contest, in document order. Excludes the 'Total' summary row printed at the foot of each contest.",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "required": [
          "office",
          "precinct",
          "votes",
          "source_page"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "office": {
            "type": "string",
            "description": "Contest this row belongs to (the page's title heading)."
          },
          "precinct": {
            "type": "string",
            "description": "Precinct label (row header), e.g. '07-2' or 'Absentee'."
          },
          "votes": {
            "type": "array",
            "description": "Vote counts in printed column order, aligned to this contest's 'columns' (candidates, then Write-In, Over Votes, Under Votes).",
            "items": {
              "type": "integer"
            }
          },
          "source_page": {
            "type": "integer",
            "description": "One-indexed PDF page where the row is printed."
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

        }

=== JSON Schema ===
{
  "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#",
  "type": "object",
  "title": "Product Spec Sheet / Datasheet — rated specifications table (vendor-agnostic)",
  "$defs": {
    "Specification": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "section": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "The spec-group heading the row is printed under — the bold/shaded band or sub-title directly above the row. Equipment spec sheets (Caterpillar): e.g. 'Engine', 'Engine rpm', 'Drive', 'Hydraulic System', 'Swing Mechanism', 'Weights', 'Track', 'Service Refill Capacities'. Electronics datasheets (TI): e.g. 'Absolute Maximum Ratings', 'ESD Ratings', 'Recommended Operating Conditions'. Record ONLY the heading words. NEVER include a leading section/clause number — strip any '5.1', '5.2', '5.3' (or '5', '6.2') prefix: a heading printed '5.1 Absolute Maximum Ratings' MUST be recorded as 'Absolute Maximum Ratings', and '5.3 Recommended Operating Conditions' as 'Recommended Operating Conditions'. Carry the current heading down to every row beneath it until a new heading appears. Do NOT confuse with: the parameter label itself (`name`), the document title, or a column header inside the table ('MIN', 'MAX', 'kg', 'lb')."
        },
        "symbol": {
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ],
          "description": "The short engineering symbol printed in the left-most symbol column of the row, when the table has one (electronics datasheets), e.g. 'VCC', 'VI', 'IO', 'TJ', 'Tstg', 'V(ESD)', 'TA'. Record the symbol text as printed with subscripts inline (no LaTeX), e.g. 'VCC', 'IO', 'TJ', 'Tstg', 'TA'. If the symbol cell is merged or blank because the row shares the symbol of the row directly above (e.g. both ESD-discharge sub-rows belong to symbol 'V(ESD)'), CARRY THE SYMBOL DOWN and record it on every shared sub-row. Use null when the table has no symbol column (Caterpillar equipment spec blocks have no symbol column — symbol is null for every Caterpillar row). Do NOT confuse with the descriptive `name` (the symbol is the abbreviation, the name is the words) or the `unit`."
        },
        "name": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "The descriptive parameter label for the row, recorded VERBATIM from the parameter column (e.g. 'Net Power - ISO 9249', 'Gross Power - ISO 14396/SAE J1995', 'Maximum Pressure - Equipment - Normal', 'Boom Cylinder - Bore', 'Supply voltage', 'Output current', 'Operating virtual junction temperature', 'Storage temperature'). Keep qualifier text that is part of the printed label (standard name, ISO/SAE reference, 'Each', '(each side)'). STRIP trailing footnote-reference markers (superscript numbers / parenthesised footnote indices such as '(1)', '(2)') and trademark symbols (®, ™): e.g. 'Supply voltage(2)' -> 'Supply voltage'. Do NOT confuse with: the `section` heading above it, the `symbol` abbreviation, or the `conditions` qualifier that lives in a separate test-conditions column."
        },
        "conditions": {
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ],
          "description": "The test-condition / package / device-variant qualifier printed in a separate conditions column or sub-cell on the row (electronics datasheets), e.g. 'CONT, RESET, THRES, TRIG', 'FK package', 'JG package, 60 seconds', 'NA555, NE555, SA555', 'SE555'. When one parameter has several rows that differ only by this qualifier (e.g. 'Operating free-air temperature' listed once per device variant), this field is what distinguishes them. Use null when the row has no separate conditions column (Caterpillar equipment rows have no conditions column — conditions is null for them). Do NOT confuse with `name` (the parameter) or `unit`."
        },
        "value": {
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ],
          "description": "The single printed measurement value for a single-value spec row, in the PRIMARY/SI unit column (Caterpillar equipment blocks list one SI value, e.g. '194', '105', '7.01', '11.50', '30 900', '50', '1,900'). Record ONLY the leading primary number exactly as printed (keep an internal space or comma in a grouped number like '30 900'); DROP the unit (it goes in `unit`), DROP any parenthetical breakdown that follows the number (e.g. '560 (280 × 2 pumps)' -> '560'; '35°/70%' -> '35°/70%' is kept since it is the whole value), and STRIP trademark symbols ® and ™ (e.g. engine model 'Cat® C7.1' -> 'Cat C7.1'). For a non-numeric spec the descriptive value goes here (e.g. engine model 'Cat C7.1', verbatim minus ®). ALSO use `value` (NOT min/max) for an electronics-datasheet table that has a single 'VALUE' column instead of MIN/MAX columns — e.g. the 'ESD Ratings' table, where the rated ESD voltage goes in `value` formatted with a leading '+/-' for the ± sign (e.g. '+/-500', '+/-1500'); leave min/typ/max null on those rows. Use null on rows that instead report a rated range via MIN/TYP/MAX columns (Absolute Maximum Ratings / Recommended Operating Conditions — leave value null and fill min/typ/max). Do NOT confuse with `value_imperial` (the second, imperial value) or with min/max."
        },
        "value_imperial": {
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ],
          "description": "The second value on a dual-unit equipment spec row — the imperial/US-customary value printed to the right of the SI value (e.g. SI '194 kW' -> imperial '260' hp; SI '105 mm' -> '4' in; SI '474 L' -> '125.2' gal; SI '30 900 kg' -> '68,200' lb; SI '5.3 km/h' -> '3.3' mph). Record only the leading number as printed without its unit (the imperial unit goes in `unit_imperial`); drop parenthetical breakdowns. Use null when the row prints only one value, when the spec is dimensionless (counts, ratios, model names), or for electronics datasheets (single-unit -> null). Do NOT confuse with `value` (the SI value) or with `max`."
        },
        "min": {
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ],
          "description": "The MIN-column value on a rated-range spec row (electronics datasheets: Absolute Maximum Ratings / Recommended Operating Conditions / ESD tables have MIN MAX UNIT columns), recorded exactly as printed e.g. '4.5', '-65', '-40', '2.75'. Use null when the MIN cell is blank or the table has no MIN column (Caterpillar single-value rows -> null). Do NOT confuse with `value` (a single SI value), `typ`, or `max`."
        },
        "typ": {
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ],
          "description": "The TYP/NOM-column value on a rated-range spec row, recorded as printed. Null when there is no TYP/NOM column or the cell is blank (the in-scope Absolute Maximum / ESD / Recommended Operating Conditions tables and all Caterpillar blocks have no TYP column, so typ is null). Do NOT confuse with `min`, `max`, or `value`."
        },
        "max": {
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"

json_schema: {"$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#", "title": "GovernmentFleetRateCard", "description": "A government fleet / motor-pool RATE CARD or FEE SCHEDULE: a flat list of rate lines, each pairing a service/fee/vehicle-class LABEL with one rate VALUE printed verbatim. Covers two shapes: (1) section-grouped fee schedules where each row is label -> single rate (e.g. Utah Fleet Operations FY2024); (2) vehicle rate grids where each vehicle Type has MULTIPLE rate columns (Rate/mile, Daily/Weekly/Monthly minimum) and each (vehicle x column) cell is ONE item (e.g. U. of Illinois Car Pool sheet).", "$defs": {"RateLine": {"type": "object", "description": "ONE rate cell: exactly one (label, basis) -> one verbatim rate value. For a section-grouped fee schedule this is one fee/service line. For a vehicle rate grid this is ONE (vehicle x rate-column) cell, so a 7-row x 4-column grid yields 28 RateLine objects.", "properties": {"section": {"type": ["string", "null"], "description": "The bold section / group HEADER this rate line sits under, VERBATIM (e.g. 'Fuel Network Rates', 'Motor Pool Rates', 'Additional Management', 'Statutory Maintenance Non-Compliance', 'Transactions Group'). Aliases: group, category header, sub-heading. Attribute every line to the nearest preceding bold header above it; carry the header down until the next bold header appears. Do NOT confuse with: the document title ('Fiscal Year 2024 Approved Rates', 'Car Pool Rate Sheet') which is NOT a section; do NOT confuse with the in-grid 'Category' column header. If the document has no section grouping (e.g. the uillinois grid has none), set this to null for every item. Location: bold left-aligned text starting a block."}, "item_label": {"type": "string", "description": "The row label naming the service, fee, or vehicle class, VERBATIM as printed including parentheticals and unit notes (e.g. 'State-Owned Sites Markup on Fuel (per gallon)', 'Service Rate (per hour)', 'Past 30 days', 'Heavy Duty On Road', 'Commercial Equipment Rental (per Unit)', 'Sedan - compact', 'Mini Van (7 passenger)'). Aliases: service, item, fee name, vehicle Type, Category. For vehicle-grid cells use ONLY the vehicle Type as the label (the rate column is captured in rate_basis), so 'Sedan - compact' appears 4 times, once per column. For indented sub-rows under a parent label (e.g. 'Past 30 days' under 'Accounts receivable late fees'), use the sub-row label as printed. Do NOT confuse with: the section header (that is 'section'); the rate value (that is 'rate_value'). Do NOT merge a parent intro line and its child rows into one. Location: leftmost text column of each row."}, "rate_basis": {"type": ["string", "null"], "description": "The unit / billing basis the rate is charged on, normalized to ONE of this fixed enum. PRIORITY RULE: if the LABEL prints an explicit unit parenthetical, that parenthetical ALWAYS wins and sets the basis, EVEN when the value is text like 'See formula' / 'Actual Cost' (so 'Lease Rate (per month, per vehicle)' -> 'per month' regardless of its 'See formula' value; 'Service Rate (per hour)' -> 'per hour'). Only when the label has NO unit parenthetical do you fall back to the value/grid-column rules below. Infer from the label parenthetical and/or the grid column header. Enum: 'per mile' (Rate/mile column; ALSO every row inside the Motor Pool mileage 'Category -> Rate' grid INCLUDING the 'Pass through' rows like 'Post EVO' and 'FO9499 - VA Supply Transport' -- they are mileage-grid rows so basis is 'per mile' even though their value is text), 'per gallon', 'per month', 'per hour', 'per occurrence', 'daily minimum' (Daily minimum grid column ONLY -- do NOT use for the Utah 'Daily Pool Rates' fee line, which has NO unit so basis is null), 'weekly minimum' (Weekly Minimum grid column), 'monthly minimum' (Monthly Minimum grid column), 'percent of balance' (use for ANY line whose rate is a bare percentage of some monetary base: the 'X% of balance' late-fee tiers AND 'Percentage of Transaction Value on Non-fuel Purchases' (3.0%) -> 'percent of balance'), 'flat' (a one-off / per-item / per-unit / per-accident / per-vehicle / per-day dollar amount with no recurring time unit, e.g. Administrative Fee, Short Term Used Vehicle Lease, Commercial Equipment Rental per Unit, Accident Deductible per accident, a '$25 per day late-return fee'), null (no determinable basis, e.g. 'Materials Rate', the 'Lease Rate ... See formula' and 'Mileage (see grid...) See formula' header lines -> basis null, 'Daily Pool Rates' / 'Actual Cost' pass-through lines with no unit, and any line whose value is 'Varies' / 'Varies(...)' and whose LABEL prints no unit -> basis null, e.g. 'Operator Negligence and Vehicle Abuse'). Mapping hints: '(per month, per vehicle)' -> 'per month'; '(per occurrence each vehicle)' -> 'per occurrence'; '(per accident)' -> 'flat'; '(per Unit)' -> 'flat'; a mileage 'Category' grid row -> 'per mile'. Do NOT confuse with: the rate_value (the number/text). Do NOT invent enum values outside this list.", "enum": ["per mile", "per gallon", "per month", "per hour", "per occurrence", "daily minimum", "weekly minimum", "monthly minimum", "percent of balance", "flat", null]}, "rate_value": {"type": "string", "description": "The rate amount EXACTLY as printed in the document, VERBATIM, including any currency symbol ($, cents sign), percent sign, or descriptive text. Do NOT normalize, parse, round, or strip: keep '$70.00' (not 70 or 70.0), '0.28' (not $0.28), '3.0%' (not 3 or 0.03), '40' for the cent value printed '40' followed by a cent sign -> use '40' ONLY if no symbol; if a cent sign is printed render it as printed (e.g. '40c' / the cents-sign char if visible), '$1.07', '5% of balance' (keep the whole phrase, not 5), 'Actual Cost', 'See formula', 'Pass through', 'Cost plus $12.00 fee', 'Varies(abuse or driver neglect cases only)' (keep the parenthetical), '155.02', '46.00'. For uillinois grid cells, take the single cell value for that (vehicle x column), e.g. Sedan-compact Daily minimum -> '$39'. Do NOT confuse with: item_label or rate_basis. This field is REQUIRED and is the load-bearing answer; never leave it blank when a value is printed. Location: the right-aligned amount on the same row, or the grid cell at (vehicle row, rate column)."}}, "required": ["item_label", "rate_value"]}}, "type": "object", "properties": {"issuing_org": {"type": ["string", "null"], "description": "The government organization / agency / department that issued this rate card, VERBATIM (e.g. 'Division of Fleet Operations' or 'Utah Division of Fleet Operations' from the Utah logo/body; 'University of Illinois Car Pool' / inferred from the Car Pool Rate Sheet + fs.illinois.edu). Aliases: agency, department, issuer, provider. Do NOT confuse with: the document title or the fiscal-year period. Location: header logo, body text ('The Division of Fleet Operations...'), or footer URL. Null only if no issuer is identifiable."}, "effective_period": {"type": ["string", "null"], "description": "The fiscal year or effective date/period the rates apply to, VERBATIM as printed (e.g. 'Fiscal Year 2024' / 'Fiscal Year 2024 Approved Rates'; 'RATES EFFECTIVE January 2, 2024' / 'effective January 2, 2024'). Aliases: fiscal year, effective date, valid period, FY. Do NOT confuse with: approval dates buried in body prose (e.g. 'approved ... on September 22, 2022') unless that is the only period given; prefer the headline effective/FY statement. Location: title line or a banner near the top. Capture the COMPLETE printed banner verbatim, INCLUDING any leading qualifier such as 'RATES EFFECTIVE' or 'Approved Rates' — do NOT strip it to a bare date (capture 'RATES EFFECTIVE January 2, 2024', not 'January 2, 2024')."}, "items": {"type": "array", "description": "Every rate line in the document, one RateLine per rate cell, in top-to-bottom reading order. Include ALL fee/service lines AND every cell of any vehicle rate grid (uillinois: 7 vehicle types x 4 rate columns = 28 items). Do NOT skip indented sub-rows (the 'Past 30/60/90 days' late-fee tiers, the in-grid Category rows like 'Heavy Duty On Road'). Do NOT collapse a vehicle grid into one item per vehicle. EXCLUDE prose footnotes/notes below a grid even if they mention a dollar amount: do NOT create an item for the uillinois 'Vehicles returned late will accrue a $25 per day late-return fee' note or any narrative caveat -- only rows that appear as a labeled rate line in the table/list itself count. So uillinois yields EXACTLY 28 items.", "items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/RateLine"}}}, "required": ["items"]}
